purpose: Explicitly distinguish real public source data from missing private facility data

available_public.use: Reference trajectory; eligibility and legal applicability must be assessed

available_public.next_action: Download current CEA version and extract the correctly defined factor and fiscal year

missing_private.access: Electricity invoices, interval meters, DISCOM portal export
missing_private.impact: Cannot calculate actual facility consumption or compliance denominator

missing_private.access: Open access schedules, settlement statements, captive generation and self-consumption records
missing_private.impact: Cannot assess designated-consumer applicability or correct RCO basis

missing_private.access: PPA contracts, REC issuance/ownership/redemption evidence, generation and allocation statements
missing_private.impact: Cannot verify eligible renewable numerator or prevent double counting

missing_private.access: Bills, PPA tariffs, open access charges, wheeling/banking and fees
missing_private.impact: Cannot calculate defensible savings or procurement ROI

policy: Missing values must be null or marked unavailable; never silently substitute sample values.
